name: Account Modal
description: Adds the ability to open account links in a modal window.
project_description: Account Modal turns Drupal's account links (login, register, password reset, account page, account cancellation, and optionally Profile add/edit) into AJAX modal dialogs instead of full-page navigations. It works entirely through core hooks: hook_link_alter adds the use-ajax + data-dialog-type=modal attributes to links pointing at the configured account routes, and hook_form_alter attaches an #ajax submit callback so the core login/register/password forms submit inside the dialog. On success it closes the dialog and either redirects or reloads the page; on error it re-renders the core form with status messages inside the modal. An admin form at /admin/config/user-interface/account-modal selects which pages open in a modal and controls dialog size, message position, field-description hiding, header/footer block injection, and (with the Profile module) an optional post-registration profile-create dialog. The forms themselves are still served by their normal core routes, so their access checks and CSRF tokens are unchanged.
